_comment: Debloat candidates. A match makes an item a CANDIDATE to show the user, never an automatic action. protected.json always wins over this file.

appxCandidates.label: Mixed Reality Portal
appxCandidates.note: Keep if you use a Windows Mixed Reality headset.

appxCandidates.label: Solitaire Collection
appxCandidates.note: It is a game - only if you never play it.

appxCandidates.label: Sticky Notes
appxCandidates.note: Notes sync to your Microsoft account; check you have none you need.

appxCandidates.label: Power Automate
appxCandidates.note: Keep if you build desktop flows.

appxCandidates.label: Microsoft To Do
appxCandidates.note: Tasks sync to your Microsoft account.

appxCandidates.label: Media Player
appxCandidates.note: Default music/video player - keep unless you use VLC/mpv etc.

appxCandidates.label: Phone Link
appxCandidates.note: Keep if you link an Android/iPhone.

appxCandidates.label: New Outlook
appxCandidates.note: Keep if this is your mail client.

appxCandidates.label: Quick Assist
appxCandidates.note: Remote help tool - keep if someone supports you remotely.

appxCandidates.label: Spotify (Store)
appxCandidates.note: Only if you do not use it.

appxCandidates.label: Preinstalled media/social promo apps
appxCandidates.note: Only those you do not use.

appxCandidates.label: OEM utility apps (HP/Lenovo/Dell/Acer/ASUS/MSI/Samsung)
appxCandidates.note: Some control fans, RGB, warranty or BIOS updates - review each.

optionalStartupPatterns.label: Epic Games Launcher
optionalStartupPatterns.note: Games still launch; the launcher just opens on demand.

optionalStartupPatterns.label: Secondary game launcher
optionalStartupPatterns.note: Games still launch; the launcher opens on demand. Never disable anti-cheat entries.

optionalStartupPatterns.label: Third-party 'optimizer' utility
optionalStartupPatterns.note: These duplicate built-in features and often cause problems.

optionalStartupPatterns.label: Cloud sync client
optionalStartupPatterns.note: Disabling stops automatic sync until you open it.

optionalStartupPatterns.label: Peripheral/RGB software
optionalStartupPatterns.note: Keep if it applies DPI/macro/fan/RGB profiles at login.

optionalMicrosoftServices.name: DiagTrack
optionalMicrosoftServices.label: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry
optionalMicrosoftServices.note: Privacy preference, not a performance fix. Prefer Settings > Privacy & security > Diagnostics & feedback > Required data only.

suspectProgramPatterns.label: Trialware / preinstalled promo
suspectProgramPatterns.note: Removing third-party AV hands protection back to Microsoft Defender automatically.

suspectProgramPatterns.pattern: CCleaner|IObit|Advanced SystemCare|Driver Booster|Driver Easy|DriverPack|Wise Care|Glary|Restoro|Reimage|Fortect|PC Optimizer|Ashampoo WinOptimizer|Razer Cortex
suspectProgramPatterns.label: Third-party optimizer / driver updater
suspectProgramPatterns.note: Not recommended: registry cleaners and generic driver updaters cause more problems than they solve.
